tasks.short: Employ foremen for direct worker supervision

steps.what: Define the actual foreman responsibilities for recruiting, hiring, instructing, assigning tasks and enforcing work rules, including the contractor's actual delegation limits.
inputs: Actual seasonal workforce needs and delegation limits
outputs: Actual foreman role and authority requirements

steps.what: Meet the actual prospective foremen and assess their experience, worker communication and ability to exercise the required direct supervision.
outputs: Actual human assessment of foreman suitability

steps.what: Choose the actual foreman and agree the employment terms and supervision scope through direct discussion, retaining the contractor's actual hiring judgement.
inputs: Actual role and delegation limits from s1
outputs: Actual chosen foreman and proposed agreed terms

steps.what: Prepare the actual foreman employment offer in {DOCS}, entering the actual terms and delegation scope; the native offer template supplies repeated employer details and established headings only.
inputs: Actual proposed terms and selected foreman from s3

steps.what: Check the actual completed foreman offer, terms, authority limits and intended recipient and authorise that final offer version for dispatch.
inputs: Actual agreed scope and terms from s1-s3
outputs: Final offer with version-and-recipient dispatch authorisation

steps.what: Save the final foreman offer in the same {DOCS} employment file.
Send the actual final foreman offer through {EMAIL} to the selected foreman, only under the final version and recipient authorisation from s5.
outputs: Actual offer sent to prospective foreman

steps.what: Confirm the foreman's actual acceptance and brief the employed foreman directly on recruiting, hiring, instruction, assignment and work-rule responsibilities, resolving questions about the delegated authority.
outputs: Actual accepted appointment and understood supervisory responsibilities, or unresolved appointment

tasks.design: Retain actual foreman selection, terms discussion and supervisory briefing. Reuse the existing offer format only for repeated employer text and headings, with the actual offer write separate from the conversation. The real offer dispatch has a final-version gate; its ordinary internal save does not. Any changed terms or recipient require s5 again. No additional monitoring report or repeated office-administration baseline is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual employment offer may repeatedly reproduce employer details while its terms and delegation still need new judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing document tool can reuse the fixed offer headings and employer block.
tasks.still_hard: A person's ability to supervise fairly and communicate work rules cannot be established by a template.
tasks.human_edge: Choose and support foremen who can work directly with the actual workforce.

ambition.what: Employ and brief the existing required foremen.

tasks.altitude: Make actual delegation limits and escalation expectations clear.

evidence.claim: A native employment-offer template can reuse fixed employer text while selection and actual terms remain human work.

assumptions: Conditional hiring workflow already includes a written foreman offer sent to the candidate; no new offer stage is invented for an oral-only arrangement.
Only 15% of offer preparation is fixed employer/headings text; actual pay, scope and terms remain manual.
Estimated shares apply to an actual appointment cycle, not daily recurring administration or foremen's ongoing labour.
Foremen's subsequent worker dealings continue unchanged; no other-role saving is claimed.
unknowns: Actual written appointment format and which fixed text is already reused
research_questions: Inspect an actual foreman appointment and time fixed text separately from selection and terms.

already_counted.description: Actual role definition, candidate assessment, hiring judgement, retained offer entry, final check, save, send and briefing

incremental.description: Keep fixed employer text and offer headings current

approvals.approved_version: Final completed offer and prospective foreman recipient checked in s5; changes require s5 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is an existing offer already using the fixed employer block, or an oral arrangement with no written offer to change; no new record or workflow is added. Where the actual written offer repeats those fields manually, s4 removes 2.25 hours per 100, less 0.5 hour upkeep. All hiring judgement, new terms and foreman briefing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Confirm the actual employees' agricultural work and which tools are appropriate for their immediate use.
inputs: Actual work assignments and employee needs

steps.what: Find and physically check the actual available tools for suitability, condition and completeness before furnishing them.
outputs: Actual selected suitable tools or a shortage

steps.what: Physically furnish the actual selected tools to the employees for their use, explaining any immediate handling point and resolving an unsuitable tool at handover.
outputs: Actual tools supplied for employee use or unresolved shortage

tasks.design: Retain actual selection, condition checking and physical tool supply. A native inventory view or loan template was considered, but no existing individual tool checkout, procurement order or issue report is established for this handout task. Do not add a trailing issue record that nobody currently keeps. Physical handover is the actual in-person work, not a proposed system send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Knowing an item exists does not make it suitable or physically available for the employee.
tasks.enabler_now: An inventory display could aid an existing lookup, but no distinct digital lookup or duplicate record is established here.
tasks.still_hard: The right tool must actually be sound and delivered to the right work.
tasks.human_edge: Notice tool damage and employee needs at the handover.
tasks.altitude: Understand actual tool suitability and shortage handling.

evidence.claim: An inventory template cannot replace actual tool condition checks and physical delivery.

assumptions: No separate manual checkout, purchase or written issue record is evidenced in this task; none is invented.
No new tagging or stock-capture programme is treated as today's labour.
The task's actual physical handover is retained rather than described as a machine transaction.
unknowns: Whether the actual operation maintains a tool loan record today
research_questions: Observe a real tool handout and identify any separately performed lookup or record before changing it.

already_counted.description: Actual tool requirements, physical inspection and handover

time_saved_range_pct.basis: After separating actual tool requirements, selection and physical furnishing, no existing written issue record, re-key or send is evidenced. A native loan form cannot remove work that is not established, and it does not remove actual tool delivery or checking. All actual work remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct and transport workers to sites

steps.what: Confirm the actual workers, pickup points and appropriate work sites with the farm contacts and workers, resolving gate locations, required arrival times and transport capacity.
inputs: Actual worker group and work-site requests
Actual site access and transport capacity
outputs: Actual confirmed stops, times and capacity constraints

steps.what: Enter the actual confirmed pickup and work-site access points, times and vehicle constraints into the existing navigation application.
inputs: Actual confirmed stops and constraints from s1

steps.what: Calculate the actual multi-stop travel sequence and estimated journey times using the existing navigation application's native routing for the supplied stops and vehicle restrictions.
inputs: Actual supplied route inputs from s2
outputs: Draft route sequence and estimated travel times

steps.what: Check the actual proposed route against known farm access, vehicle suitability and actual worker arrival constraints, correcting unsuitable stops or route assumptions.
inputs: Actual access and capacity constraints from s1
outputs: Actual usable transport route or manual alternative

steps.what: Direct the actual workers to the appropriate vehicle and site, explain the actual destination and coordinate boarding and the group at pickup.
inputs: Actual workers and usable route from s1-s4
outputs: Actual workers directed and boarded for the appropriate sites

steps.what: Physically transport the actual workers to their appropriate work sites, driving attentively and adapting to the actual road, weather and access conditions.
outputs: Actual workers transported to the sites

steps.what: Direct the workers at actual arrival to the correct work-site contact and access point, resolving any immediate destination mismatch.
outputs: Actual workers delivered and directed to the appropriate work site

tasks.design: Use native routing only where today's active work includes manual multi-stop route calculation. OTHER is the actual vehicle, phone and existing navigation application. Actual addresses, constraints and their entry are counted; no clean roster or farm-gate feed appears for free. Keep all worker direction, boarding, driving and arrival work. Do not add automated messages or a new delivery-completion report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Several actual pickup and site stops may require manually comparing route order and travel times.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing navigation tool can calculate that exact route from supplied stops and constraints.
tasks.still_hard: A routable road may lead to an unsuitable farm gate, and actual transport still requires driving and coordination.
tasks.human_edge: Deliver the actual workers safely to the correct site contact.

ambition.what: Direct and transport the existing worker group.

tasks.altitude: Know actual access constraints rather than rely on an address centroid.

evidence.claim: Native routing can calculate supplied multi-stop routes without replacing actual stop confirmation, driving or worker direction.

assumptions: Conditional baseline includes a real manually compared multi-stop route; no route-calculation baseline is invented for a familiar single stop.
Shares estimate active labour, with only 3% allocated to the actual calculation and none to unattended route runtime.
Entry in s2 is existing route preparation work, not new uncompensated capture.
Existing native automatic routing earns no additional saving; no separate transport record or message is established.
unknowns: Actual route complexity, manual planning time and current navigation use
research_questions: Observe an actual multi-stop run and separate manual route comparison from stop confirmation and physical transport.

already_counted.description: Actual stop confirmation, input entry, suitability check, worker direction, driving and arrival

incremental.description: Maintain actual farm-gate and vehicle restriction settings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is a familiar single-stop journey or routing already calculated natively; no new planning action is introduced and no change is claimed. For real manual multi-stop comparison with supplied compatible stops, remove its 3 hours per 100, less 0.5 hour settings upkeep. All actual driving and worker coordination remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Define actual foreman authority and practical transport constraints while keeping hiring, worker support and physical tool supply.
skills_to_grow: Distinguishing fixed offer text from actual employment terms
role.ambitious_version: A contractor who removes proven repeated text and route calculation while staying accountable for foremen and actual worker arrangements.
